title: Missing Display on EmailAddress
description: mime-tree/src/header_typed.rs:40-46 — EmailAddress is a user-visible public type (it surfaces in JMAP-shaped responses, log lines, error messages) but only derives Debug. RFC 5322 §3.4 defines a canonical text representation ("Name" <addr@example.com>) for a mailbox; that is the natural Display. Forcing every caller that wants a human-readable form to roll their own formatter is the leaky-abstraction smell the prompt's traits section calls out. Adding impl fmt::Display would let callers use {addr} in format strings and error chains. Existing finding MIME-o2c.14 covers the Option<String> ergonomics on the address field; this is a separate trait-impl gap.
close_reason: Type-definition cleanup batch on the typed header surface: (.4) added #[non_exhaustive] to EmailAddress and AddressGroup (HeaderDateTime was already done); (.5) dropped Copy from HeaderDateTime; (.26) dropped Copy from HeaderForm; (.18/.19/.20) added Display impls — RFC 5322 §3.4 mailbox/group form for EmailAddress/AddressGroup, RFC 3339 form for HeaderDateTime; (.34/.35) added Hash on EmailAddress/AddressGroup/HeaderDateTime/HeaderValueTyped; (.36) added Default on EmailAddress/AddressGroup; (.33) symmetric by-value internal signature on to_mail_parser/from_mail_parser. New public constructors EmailAddress::new and AddressGroup::new for callers blocked by #[non_exhaustive]. New tests cover Display, Hash, and TzSign.
